name: cadabra
description: Cadabra AI turns one sentence in ChatGPT into finished video ads, short films and pictures.

interface.shortDescription: Video ads & films in one chat
interface.longDescription:
Cadabra AI is a full creative studio inside ChatGPT for businesses and creators. Say what you want in one sentence, add a product photo or a selfie if you have one, and get a finished ad, film or picture right in the chat.

Made for businesses:
- Product ads: turn one product photo into image ads, a giant product in a city street, or a short video ad.
- Video ads and films: go from one idea to a cut film with scenes, voiceover, music and captions.
- Brand content: keep the same character, product or presenter in every shot, with talking avatars and translated versions.

One-photo magic: dozens of ready transformations, like you in 1985, hugging your younger self, an action figure in its box, a fashion magazine cover, a Renaissance portrait, anime and a plush toy.

Voice and sound: narration in your own voice, dialogue between characters, songs, music and sound effects, in English and Hebrew.

How it works:
1. Connect your Cadabra AI account.
2. Ask in plain words. Cadabra picks the right engine and writes the expert prompt for you.
3. Before anything is made, you see exactly what will run and approve it.
4. Your result appears in the chat and is saved to your Cadabra gallery.

Your creations stay in your own account at livinginmovie.com.
capabilities: Video ads with voiceover, music and captions
Consistent characters and products across shots
Narration in your own voice, songs and sound effects
defaultPrompt: Turn my product photo into a giant billboard-style ad in a busy city street
Make a 30-second video ad for my coffee shop, with voiceover, music and captions
Turn my selfie into a real photo from 1985

positive.description: Reads the connected account's credit balance. Read-only, charges nothing.
positive.prompt: How many Cadabra credits do I have left?
positive.expected_behavior: Replies with the remaining credit balance of the connected account, for example "58 credits remaining (2 used of 60)". No generation runs and nothing is charged.

positive.description: Generates one image. The price is shown first and nothing is charged until the user approves.
positive.prompt: Make an image of a red fox reading a newspaper in a cozy cafe, warm cinematic light
positive.expected_behavior: First shows a quote with the credit price and the exact prompt, and asks for approval. After the user approves, generates the image and shows it in the chat (in the Cadabra card), and it is saved to the user's Cadabra gallery.

positive.description: Generates a short video, quoted first, then rendered after approval.
positive.prompt: Make a 5-second video of ocean waves rolling onto a beach at sunset
positive.expected_behavior: Shows the price and the engine before anything is charged and asks for approval. After approval the video renders (usually one to three minutes) and the finished clip plays in the chat.

positive.description: Lists what the user already made. Read-only.
positive.prompt: Show me my recent Cadabra creations
positive.expected_behavior: Lists the most recent items in the user's Cadabra gallery with their type, a link to each file and the prompt it was made from, or says the gallery is empty on a fresh account. Nothing is charged.

positive.description: Writes a storyboard for an idea without rendering anything. Free.
positive.prompt: Write a storyboard for a 30-second ad for a small neighborhood coffee shop
positive.expected_behavior: Returns a shot-by-shot storyboard (shots with what the camera sees and what is heard) and offers to produce it. Nothing is rendered and nothing is charged.

negative.description: An unrelated question. Cadabra should not be called.
negative.prompt: What is the weather in Paris today?

negative.description: A request to buy credits. The plugin does not sell or link to any purchase; at most it reports the current balance.
A request too vague to price. Cadabra should ask what the video is about, and charge nothing.

review.commerce_description: Cadabra AI does not sell anything inside ChatGPT. Users connect an existing Cadabra AI account and use the credits already in it; every paid action shows its price and waits for the user's approval.

publication.release_notes: Business-first listing: product ads from one photo, video ads with voiceover, music and captions, and one-photo transformations.
